overview: Based on the published agenda, this special Village Board meeting in Kronenwetter was scheduled to address the acceptance of the Village Clerk's resignation. The meeting represents an important personnel matter requiring board action.

discussions.body: The Village Board was scheduled to consider and take action on the resignation of the Village Clerk. This personnel matter was set for discussion and possible action during the new business portion of the meeting.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Expected to vote on acceptance of Village Clerk's resignation
title: Special Village Board Meeting - 2026-08-27
